stitch_assoc:
by
  induction xs with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons x xs ih => simp only [stitch, ih]
map_stitch:
by
  induction xs with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons x xs ih => simp only [stitch, transform, ih]
size_stitch:
by
  induction xs with
  | nil => simp [stitch, size]
  | cons x xs ih => simp only [stitch, size]; omega
map_comp:
by
  induction xs with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons x xs ih => simp only [transform, ih]
fold_stitch:
by
  induction xs generalizing z with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons x xs ih => simp only [stitch, fold]; exact ih (f z x)
size_map:
by
  induction xs with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons x xs ih => simp only [transform, size, ih]
forall_and:
by
  constructor
  · intro h; exact ⟨fun x => (h x).1, fun x => (h x).2⟩
  · intro h x; exact ⟨h.1 x, h.2 x⟩
exists_or:
by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨x, hp | hq⟩
    · exact Or.inl ⟨x, hp⟩
    · exact Or.inr ⟨x, hq⟩
  · rintro (⟨x, hp⟩ | ⟨x, hq⟩)
    · exact ⟨x, Or.inl hp⟩
    · exact ⟨x, Or.inr hq⟩
exists_and:
by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨x, hp, hq⟩; exact ⟨⟨x, hp⟩, hq⟩
  · rintro ⟨⟨x, hp⟩, hq⟩; exact ⟨x, hp, hq⟩
not_exists:
by
  constructor
  · intro h x hx; exact h ⟨x, hx⟩
  · intro h hx; rcases hx with ⟨x, hp⟩; exact h x hp
injective_comp:
by
  intro a b h; exact hf a b (hg (f a) (f b) h)
left_inverse:
by
  intro a b hab
  calc
    a = g (f a) := (h a).symm
    _ = g (f b) := congrArg g hab
    _ = b := h b
surjective_comp:
by
  intro y
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := hg y
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hf b
  exact ⟨a, by rw [ha, hb]⟩
right_inverse:
by
  intro y; exact ⟨g y, h y⟩
double_add:
by
  induction b with
  | zero => simp [double]
  | succ b ih =>
    change double (a + b) + 2 = double a + (double b + 2)
    rw [ih, Nat.add_assoc]
double_value:
by
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih => simp only [double]; omega
scale_add:
by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp [scale]
  | succ n ih =>
    change scale a (m + n) + a = scale a m + (scale a n + a)
    rw [ih, Nat.add_assoc]
scale_value:
by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp [scale]
  | succ n ih => simp [scale, ih, Nat.mul_succ]
tri_lower:
by
  induction n with
  | zero => exact Nat.le_refl 0
  | succ n ih => simp only [tri]; omega
double_even:
by
  refine ⟨n, ?_⟩
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih => simp only [double]; omega
